exposure: Betamethasone administration (12 mg IM, two doses 24 hours apart) in pregnant women
outcome: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: The study included 100 women with singleton pregnancies (28 - 36 weeks gestational age), aged 19-33 years, not in labor but at risk for pre-term delivery.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroids like betamethasone significantly reduce neonatal respiratory distress syndrome and NICU admission rates when given at 28-34 weeks of gestational age, with benefits observed even after 34 weeks of pregnancy.
gest_age: Intervention given at 28-34 weeks of gestation; cohort enrolled at 28-36 weeks gestational age.
